asset_groups.origin: Forensic feature matching maps the shipped satellite blocks to archived Esri World Imagery captures retrieved on 2026-08-16. N04 sources were static MapServer /export PNG responses; the N01 source was a limited small-area tiled-service capture composed into one static research map. The public package ships only annotated static derivatives, not raw tiles, an offline basemap package, or an independently reusable source image. The user-provided Baidu Maps screenshot (source hash 9bf8eea81a3ea4e0986922675f023a902f02e18ec88214907e5ec292148a53c7) is an upstream spatial reference for the N02 generated workflow and is not shipped as a standalone map component.

license_or_permission.scope: Annotated static electronic and printed maps in this participant PR and noncommercial community review only; no raw-tile redistribution, offline basemap package, self-hosting, commercial reuse, or standalone source reuse
provider_permission_basis: The World Imagery item is public and expressly licensed under the Esri Master License Agreement.
Esri's official item-use summary permits screen captures and printed or plotted maps for internal or external projects when attribution is provided.

Esri Support article 000012040 expressly documents ArcGIS Online basemap use in publications, printed material, and public exhibitions, with attribution on or near the map or in a nearby credit panel.
license_or_permission.provider_export_notice: The World Imagery restriction concerns exporting basemap tiles for offline use. It does not convert an attributed static map image used in a publication or exhibition into an offline tile package.
license_or_permission.required_attribution: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
license_or_permission.evidence_conclusion: The shipped use is an attributed static-map derivative, not redistribution of basemap tiles or an offline basemap package. A World Imagery (for Export) entitlement is therefore outside the declared use and is not a missing publication-rights dependency.
